name: Curb alert
summary: Free stuff someone left on the curb, drawn at street level: tap a thing and claim it, a little dolly with your face rolls in and wheels it off, and it is gone from the curb for everyone else.
useWhen: 'free stuff on pine st, someone put out a bookshelf and a chair'
curb alert!! who wants the desk chair
dibs on free furniture someone left outside
a free pile on the street during move-out week
who's grabbing what from the free stuff before it's gone
dontUseWhen: selling your own things before a move (use box-sorter or move-out-sale)
planning a car to pick something up (use pickup-run)
a listing with a price (use price-check)

place.description: Where on the street, e.g. 'outside 418 Pine'

spotted.description: Who spotted it and their line

items.description: 1 to 5 things on the curb: name and kind (bookshelf, chair, mugs, lamp, table, mirror, box)

claims.description: Things already claimed: item index, who, a short line
